newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Jan-March c/a deficit $1.323 bln.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Jan-March c/a deficit $1.323 bln.

text.p: Turkey's current account deficit in the January to March period rose to $1.323 billion from $684 million a year earlier, the central bank said.

The figures exclude Turkey's sizeable so-called "suitcase" exports -- typically purchases by Russians who cross the border to buy low-cost Turkish goods and take them back to Russia to sell at a handsome profit. The most popular items for suitcase traders are textiles, leather clothing andsmallhousehold appliances. Payments are for cash in U.S. dollars.
If these exports are included, Turkey's current account deficit rose to $713 million in the three-month period from $167 million a year earlier.
Turkey's current account had produced a $4.39 billion deficit in 1996, up from $2.34 billion in 1995.
